title: Open House, in full color
question: Same colorful visual system, three different layouts. Choose what should carry forward, or add a revision below. These are design mockups with illustrative data.

options.label: Side-by-side
options.thesis: A steady event index beside a boldly colored workspace.
options.viewport: Hackathon opens a queue; Demo Day a gallery; Code & Tell a project list beside a ballot.
options.risk: The event index costs space on a laptop and must collapse on phones.

options.label: Event stage
options.thesis: The selected format takes over the canvas.
options.viewport: A horizontal event selector sits above a full-width, mode-specific entry with its primary action built into the layout.
options.risk: Large color fields need enough useful content to earn their space.

options.label: Open lobby
options.thesis: See how each event works before choosing one.
options.viewport: Three unequal event panels expose a judging queue, a project gallery, and a ballot preview directly in the lobby.
options.risk: Several active events may compete for attention; mobile needs a clear ordering.
